_purpose: Provenance for every election figure in src/data/state_election_history.json. scripts/build_election_history.js reads this file and copies it into the output, so the application can show the source of any number it displays.

elections.label: Assembly 2014
elections.publisher: Trivedi Centre for Political Data (TCPD), Ashoka University — LokDhaba, redistributed by OpenCity
elections.underlying_source: Election Commission of India statistical report
elections.licence: Public domain (as listed by OpenCity); cite TCPD LokDhaba
elections.notes: Held as part of undivided Andhra Pradesh; the 119 Telangana seats are on the 2008 delimitation, identical to 2018 and 2023. Party 'TRS' is BRS's former name.

elections.label: Assembly 2018
elections.publisher: Trivedi Centre for Political Data (TCPD), Ashoka University — LokDhaba, redistributed by OpenCity
elections.underlying_source: Election Commission of India statistical report
elections.licence: Public domain (as listed by OpenCity); cite TCPD LokDhaba
elections.notes: Includes TCPD's incumbent / turncoat / last-party fields per candidate.

elections.label: Assembly 2023
elections.publisher: Election Commission of India — Statistical Report, '10 - Detailed Results'
elections.notes: Byte-identical to the OpenCity copy. Party code 'BHRS' is BRS. Votes include postal ballots.

elections.label: Lok Sabha 2024 (assembly segment)
elections.publisher: Election Commission of India — Statistical Report '34 - Details of Assembly Segment of PC', redistributed by OpenCity
elections.notes: EVM votes only — postal ballots are counted per parliamentary seat, not per assembly segment, so segment shares exclude them. Filtered to Telangana from the all-India file. A national election: shown alongside assembly results, never mixed into the loyalty score.

governments._purpose: The government formed after each election. The build verifies each state entry against the computed seat tally: the named party must hold a majority (60 of 119) in that election's results.

lok_sabha._purpose: Full results for Telangana's 17 Lok Sabha (MP) seats. Each seat's result is its own contest; an assembly seat sits inside one of them. The build verifies each year's Telangana tally against `declared`.

elections.label: Lok Sabha 2014
elections.publisher: Election Commission of India — Constituency-wise Detailed Results, via India Data Portal
elections.notes: Polled as part of undivided Andhra Pradesh; the 17 Telangana seats are filtered by name. Votes are general + postal.

elections.label: Lok Sabha 2019
elections.publisher: Trivedi Centre for Political Data (TCPD), Ashoka University — LokDhaba, via OpenCity

elections.label: Lok Sabha 2024
elections.publisher: Election Commission of India — constituency-wise results, via OpenCity

segments.publisher: Election Commission of India — Assembly Segment-wise Results, via OpenCity

bypolls.notes: Assembly by-elections after 2023. Only the leading candidates and NOTA are published in the cited tables, so these carry the reported vote share rather than a full candidate list.

excluded.why: No machine-readable party-wise segment file was found; the OpenCity 2019 segment file carries electors and turnout only.

The per-seat census attributes in the OpenCity constituency map are column-shifted and half zero; unusable. Census 2011 predates Telangana's 2016 district reorganisation, so only Hyderabad has a district figure on its present territory.
